correctness.rationale: A prescribed pair of leaves adjacent to a chosen center corresponds bijectively to any Cayley tree on r=n−2 remaining labels, with probability r^{r−2}/n^{n−2}; the conditional reduced tree is uniform. Exactly W_n=W_r+2Σ_x d(c,x)+2r+2; exchangeability gives EΣ_xd=2μ_r/r. Count all n binom(n−1,2) cherry indicators to derive mixed moment. The path between two labeled vertices has tail Pr(D_m≥k)=∏_{j=2}^k(1−j/m), from fixed-path forest-extension Laplacian, so μ_m exact. Q_n=2(n−1)−3d_{n−2}−binom(n,2)(d_n−d_{n−2}). For n≥627, K=floor(sqrt(n−2))≥25 and telescoping products give d_n−d_{n−2}>(4/n), forcing Q_n<−3d_{n−2}<0. Independent Fraction arithmetic checked every 4≤n≤626, while independent BFS over ALL 18,247 Prüfer-labelled trees for n=3..7 reproduced the covariance (n4 −9/16, n5 −696/625, n6 −440/243). Gaussian-product/Riemann sums give Δ_n∼√(π/2)/√n and EC_n∼e^−2 n/2, hence stated asymptotic. Certificates finite only for explicitly complete 4..626 interval; analytic tail handles infinitely many.

value.rationale: Relates a canonical local symmetry-bearing motif (pair of sibling leaves) to a canonical global metric index on all uniform labelled trees, with exact finite covariance, strict universal sign and nontrivial n^{5/2} asymptotic constant. The cross-statistic dependence is not determined by either separately-known marginal; meaningful structural probability theorem, not a routine substitution.

final_claim: For uniform unrooted labelled Cayley trees T_n, the cherry count C_n (every unordered pair of leaves sharing a center, no center-degree restriction) has exact covariance with Wiener index W_n equal to EC_n[((n+2)/(n−2))μ_{n−2}+2(n−1)−μ_n], with EC_n=n binom(n−1,2)(n−2)^{n−4}/n^{n−2} and μ_m=binom(m,2)d_m for d_m=Σ_{k=1}^{m−1}∏_{j=2}^k(1−j/m). It is zero at n=3, negative for every n≥4, and asymptotic to −(e^−2/4)√(π/2) n^{5/2}.
limitations: Potential broader unpublished joint tree-motif generating functions; 1994 Entringer–Meir–Moon–Székely full original text not read.
